messages:
sam: Quick heads-up — we repro a p95 tail when host-ingress gets lots of tiny offloads + a mid-size gen at same time. baseline ~18ms -> spike ~47ms.

katie: Can you paste the minimal trace?

sam: trace: `request -> kvcache.miss -> ingress.queue -> host_alloc.pin -> dma_submit -> completion` 
Multiple ingress.queue tasks serialized on the same staging-slot waiter.

diego: Is this the sidecar ingress queue we've been prototyping?

sam: Yeah, the allocator-sidecar takes offload requests and drives host pin + dma. It batches by tenant but batching was disabled for single-shot flows.

katie: Two quick fixes: enable tiny coalescing for single-shot paths (small window 3ms) OR give sidecar per-tenant fast-slot pool.

diego: Per-tenant pool avoids head-of-line blocking but increases host mem. Coalescing is cheaper but adds micro-latency for singles.

sam: We did a canary: 3ms coalesce -> p95 went to ~22ms, p99 mostly unchanged. Host mem +2.5%.

katie: Good. If we also add a tiny fastpath slab for <=256B inside sidecar we can avoid host mmap on the hot path. That plus coalesce should be pretty robust.

diego: Agree. Need to define eviction for sidecar slabs: either sidecar returns slab pages to global pool asynchronously or relies on sidecar-local compaction.

sam: My preference: sidecar keeps ephemeral slabs pinned and exposes a drain API to global allocator. On pressure, global allocator signals `drain_now` and sidecar either compacts or hands back pages.

katie: Add telemetry: sidecar_queue_depth, coalesce_hits, slab_local_free_pct, drain_requests, and drain_latency.

diego: Also add a fallback path: if coalesce window would add >1ms for critical tenants, skip coalesce and use tokenized fast-slot tokens.

ops-bot: Created EXP-2024-789: "sidecar ingress coalesce + tiny-slab experiment" assigned [sam, katie, diego].

sam: I'll open a small PR toggling coalesce for single-shot flows and add metrics. Diego can prototype sidecar-slab after that.

katie: I'll draft the drain API and telemetry layout. We should run a mixed-load sim (90% tiny hits, 10% long gen) to ensure no regressions.

diego: Will add a stress harness. If results look good, we roll to 5% tenants behind flag.

sam: Thanks — keeping this narrow should let us iterate fast. :thumbsup:
